propositions: Repository-effective project LLM criteria are injected exactly once into round_a and never injected into round_b, whose bounded membership remains escalation/overlay-controlled.
Each project finding retains its logical criterion id in the project.<name> namespace throughout the four-pass gate flow.
The repository-scoped effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for logical project ids in Pass 3.
A project code-review id active in exactly one gate resolves and calibrates through the code-review arm of criteria eval; unknown and cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration.
An activated project criterion with missing or invalid prompt/eval specification raises a located configuration error rather than silently falling back.
